title: Flux 3
summary: Flux 3 is the latest iteration of Black Forest Labs' open-source image generation model series, continuing the Flux lineage of diffusion-based image synthesis with potential improvements in quality, speed, and capabilities.
problem_solved: Provides state-of-the-art AI image generation capabilities for creators and developers seeking high-quality, open-source image synthesis tools.
why_valuable: Black Forest Labs' Flux series has been highly influential in democratizing advanced image generation, and Flux 3 likely brings further improvements that push the boundaries of what's possible with open-source AI image synthesis.
